# WeChat Classic Emoticons

Files 0.gif through 104.gif are the classic emoticon artwork distributed from
Tencent's public WeChat resource host:

https://res.wx.qq.com/mpres/htmledition/images/icon/emotion/{index}.gif

Retrieved 2026-09-22 for faithful, offline presentation of existing WeChat
message codes. Artwork belongs to its respective rights holder; no original
authorship or additional license grant is claimed here. Modern codes without
classic artwork use explicitly mapped Unicode glyphs instead.
